headings.usage: Marketplace titles, section headers, product names

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-[#2A2A2A], 1px solid border-blue-500/30 for official SpotU items
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-[32px] for modal top, rounded-full for pills and tags
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-lg shadow-black/50 for modal, inner glow (shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]) for SpotU premium cards
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/85 for sticky header and fixed bottom actions
visual_enhancers.opacity: opacity-60 for secondary text and out-of-stock items

components.name: MarketplaceTrigger
components.description: Button to open the marketplace, placed next to Similaires. Uses marketplace_primary color.
components.classes: flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#3B82F6] px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-white transition-transform active:scale-95

components.name: MarketplaceModal
components.description: Bottom sheet modal sliding up from the bottom.
components.classes: fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-50 flex h-[90vh] flex-col rounded-t-[32px] border-t border-[#2A2A2A] bg-[#0A0A0A] shadow-2xl

components.name: FilterList
components.description: Horizontal scrollable list of filter pills.
components.classes: flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto px-6 py-4 scrollbar-none

components.name: FilterPill
components.description: Interactive pill for filtering. Active state uses marketplace_primary.
components.classes_active: rounded-full bg-[#3B82F6] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white
components.classes_inactive: rounded-full bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-[#2A2A2A] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-[#EDEDED]

components.name: ProductCard
components.description: Horizontal card displaying product details. Non-clickable.
components.classes: flex gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-[#2A2A2A] bg-[#1A1A1A] p-4

components.name: SpotUProductCard
components.description: Premium variant of the product card for SpotU official products.
components.classes: flex gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-blue-500/30 bg-[#1A1A1A] relative overflow-hidden p-4 before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-blue-500/5 before:pointer-events-none

grids_and_layouts.card_layout: Image wrapper left (w-28 h-28), Content right (flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between)

accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, cards, and tags MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format. E.g., data-testid='marketplace-trigger-button', data-testid='filter-pill-tous'.
accessibility.aria_roles: Use dialog role for the modal, tablist for filters.

images.description: yellow and blue tennis racket (Sport Equipment)

media.image_aspect_ratios: Product images must be 1:1 square, object-cover.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Marketplace as a React functional component (.js file) inside the existing SpotYou detail page structure.
The Marketplace modal should be styled as a mobile Bottom Sheet (fixed to bottom, rounded top corners).
Ensure the new Marketplace brand color (Cobalt Blue #3B82F6) is used distinctly from the existing Teal (#00BFA5) and Orange (#FF9500).
Product Cards MUST be display-only (no a tags, no cursor-pointer, no onClick) as per requirements.
Implement the Filter Tabs with horizontal scrolling (overflow-x-auto, scrollbar-none).
Create a visual distinction between SpotU (platform) products and Creator products. Use a subtle blue border/glow for SpotU products.
Include tags on the card for: type (Vente/Location), Skill level, Stock status, and Seller.
Ensure the modal header is sticky to the top of the sheet with a blur effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/85). Do not use fully transparent headers.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Apply the configured 'Outfit' font for titles and 'Manrope' for body text.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft inner shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for sticky navigation or modal headers.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react or ionicons.
Always use modern pill-shaped or rounded-2xl elements.
Do not apply global transitions like 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions to interactive elements.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive or informational component.
